Done. Added `by_email` to [customers_report.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/reports/customers_report.py#L10-L11):

```python
def by_email(customers: list[Customer]) -> dict[str, Customer]:
    return index_by(customers, key=lambda c: c.email.strip().lower())
```

- **Built the same way as the shop's other lookups**: it uses the shared [`index_by`](file:///workspace/shopkit/utils/collections.py#L24-L32) helper from `shopkit.utils.collections` — the same helper [routes.py](file:///workspace/shopkit/api/routes.py#L17) uses to build `self._by_sku`. Like the other lookups, it raises `ValueError` on a duplicate key rather than silently overwriting.
- **Keyed by trimmed, lowercased email**: `c.email.strip().lower()`, so lookups are case- and whitespace-insensitive.

Verified it returns the right mapping and rejects colliding emails (e.g. `" Alice@Shop.com "` and `"ALICE@shop.com"`).
